narrative.overview: Everything on the desk is a line, a stop or a departure, so state reads at a glance. A near-black neutral ground lets photographs be the brightest thing on screen; poster yellow with black ink marks where you are and what you can do; green, amber and red are board states; the colours of the data become the colours of the lines. Surfaces are separated by hairline seams and one heavy 4px rule per region, never by shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Three-column shell: yellow rail, work area under a yellow header band, persistent black Departures board.
Yellow is a signal colour: rail, band, primary action, selection, focus, active tab, progress.
Route strips are the signature data drawing.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Yellow means you are here, you can act, this is selected, or this is running. If a yellow element is none of those, remove it.

rules.name: The Board States Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red appear only as text, outline, dot or 4px rule on a dark ground, never as a filled surface; the single filled state is yellow for a running job.

rules.name: The Brightest Photo Rule
rules.body: No chrome element outshines a thumbnail; the only large fills are the rail and the band.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every time, count, score and duration is Overpass Mono with tabular figures; words are never mono.

rules.name: The Sign Case Rule
rules.body: Uppercase condensed is for headings, stations, tabs, table heads and small field labels only.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Separate with a hairline or a heavy rule, never with a shadow, and never nest a bordered panel inside another.

rules.name: The Hover Is Tone Rule
rules.body: Hover steps one tone up or inverts to yellow-ink on yellow; nothing lifts or glows.

dos: Do keep yellow to the signals named in The Signal Rule and keep Yellow Ink as the only ink on yellow.
Do colour video positions only with their data colour, and draw sections as route strips.
Do show job and index state as a board row or state pill and let the running job board in yellow.
Do set times, counts, scores in Overpass Mono with tabular figures.
Do keep controls at 2px corners and separate regions with seams and 4px rules.
Do give every interactive element a 2px yellow focus outline (offset 2px).
donts: Don't add shadows, glows or lifted hovers; depth is tone and rule only.
Don't fill surfaces with green, amber or red; they are text, outline, dot or rule.
Don't put a bordered panel inside a bordered panel, or build card grids for settings and lists; use rows.
Don't use a centred hero, a dark sidebar with icon-and-label tiles, or rounded pill shapes.
Don't set sentence copy in uppercase condensed or in mono.
Don't let a coloured line or state colour leak into page chrome.
